PART D. OBSERVATIONS NEAR MOSCOW
The three observers were escorted to a place which Senator Russell had requested to see outside Moscow. On the way, exactly at the 42 kilometer signpost from Moscow on the Moscow to Minsk highway, on the right side of the road, there was a radar site (size unknown) with two radars. From the sketches of Col. Hathaway, they have been tentatively identified as one Woodgage or Gage and one square type [illegible] Freya. (See sketch below): (Approx. 200-250 yards off side of road.)
